notes: A key is the tuple of modelled predicate results (1/0/None) for one dependency component; None is a distinct opaque value.
The candidate universe is the parsed class list, so class counts are exact for modelled predicates, not a panel sample.
Predicate calls inside lambdas are not recovered; rule sets with lambdas are listed in opaque_builders and keep the floor of the modelled quotient.
unrepresented counts quotient classes the target boundary panel never touches; it is a panel-coverage diagnostic, not a gate.
